answer.justification: The activation profile matches system-prompted: relative L2 climbs steeply from 0.141 at layer 1 to 0.304 at layer 8 and plateaus at 0.478 at layer 16 and 0.501 at layer 32. The onset layer is 8, the final-layer cosine is 0.849, the effective rank is 2.77, and the direction consistency is 0.538. All of these fall in or near the system-prompted ranges. The size ratio of 0.972 is slightly below 1, which also fits system-prompted and rules out fine-tuned (it grows, 1.017+). Quantized is ruled out because its curve is flat (about 0.2 at layer 24, 0.25 at layer 32) and its rank is about 4. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the size ratio, the cosine and the layer-16 and layer-32 magnitudes. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is far below the expected 31.7–64.0, which is the one inconsistent feature and lowers my confidence. It is also not base, since the differences are non-zero.
